Baseline sour… ou are participating in an independent game-development benchmark. Inputs you must use Baseline source archive: https://github.com/Skalagrimmo/diablo-nes-demake/archive/refs/heads/benchmark/baseline-2026-10-30.zip Baseline commit: dd1a795cebb12366fd3d6062e4d33c177415ba9b Shared design and acceptance brief: https://github.com/Skalagrimmo/diablo-nes-demake/blob/66b5c97098400a447ac8fe65d43477ee50a5c8d5/docs/AI-BENCHMARK-BRIEF.md Read the complete shared brief before implementation. Your task Create an independently playable evolution of the supplied game under the working title The Last Reactor. This must become a distinct game, not a palette swap or a generic Diablo clone. Rules for a fair comparison Work only from the supplied baseline archive and shared brief. Do not inspect, reuse, or request another participant's implementation. Do not assume hidden context from previous conversations. Do not claim a feature works unless it is implemented and checked. Do not claim Android/mobile, performance, offline or save compatibility unless tested. Do not add paid services, required accounts, analytics, network dependencies or remote assets. Prefer original, generated-at-build-time or licensed assets. Do not spend the entire task on planning. Minimum expected gameplay Deliver a coherent, playable vertical slice that includes: character movement and responsive primary controls; at least two enemy behaviours that are meaningfully different; combat or another clear encounter-resolution mechanic; rewards and at least one meaningful character/equipment progression choice; at least one environmental interaction that changes access or world state; at least one boss or major encounter; a save/continue path or an explicitly justified equivalent; a distinctive district of the industrial city, with at least one visible route or landmark that makes the world feel connected; desktop keyboard controls and usable mobile touch controls, unless the participant-specific addendum specifies a native platform implementation—in that case native touch input is required. A smaller complete and polished slice is preferable to a broad but broken feature list. Delivery package Provide: Full source project and all required assets. Test report separating passed tests, failed tests and untested areas. Do not optimize for superficial feature count.
